scripts.deploy: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');function cp(src,dst){if(!fs.existsSync(dst))fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(src)){const s=path.join(src,f),d=path.join(dst,f);fs.statSync(s).isDirectory()?cp(s,d):fs.copyFileSync(s,d);}}cp('dist','../web/mobile-app');console.log('Deployed dist/ → web/mobile-app/');"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && node ./node_modules/@capacitor/cli/bin/capacitor sync android
